mods.name: ChatZLE
mods.description: Zsh-style command-line editing, persistent history and autosuggestions for Minecraft chat.

releases.notes:
## English

The first public release of ChatZLE, a client-only Fabric mod that brings zsh/ZLE-style editing to the Minecraft chat command line.

### Highlights

- Persistent per-server command history and inline autosuggestions
- `Ctrl-R` fuzzy reverse history search
- Prefix-aware history navigation
- ZLE-inspired movement, kill ring, yank/yank-pop, and transpose shortcuts
- Command abbreviations and sensitive-command filtering
- ChatZLE history suggestions coexist with the vanilla Brigadier completion popup

### Requirements

- Minecraft 1.21.11
- Fabric Loader 0.18.4 or newer
- Fabric API for Minecraft 1.21.11
- Fabric Language Kotlin 1.13.9+kotlin.2.3.10 or newer
- Java 21

Install `chatzle-1.0.0.jar` on the client only. No server-side installation is required.

## 简体中文

ChatZLE 首个公开版本。这是一个纯客户端 Fabric Mod，为 Minecraft 聊天命令行带来类似 zsh/ZLE 的编辑体验。

### 主要功能

- 按服务器隔离的持久化命令历史和行内提示
- `Ctrl-R` 模糊反向历史搜索
- 基于当前前缀的历史导航
- 类似 ZLE 的移动、kill ring、yank/yank-pop 和交换快捷键
- 命令缩写与敏感命令过滤
- ChatZLE 历史提示可与原版 Brigadier 补全窗口同时工作

### 运行要求

- Minecraft 1.21.11
- Fabric Loader 0.18.4 或更高版本
- 适用于 Minecraft 1.21.11 的 Fabric API
- Fabric Language Kotlin 1.13.9+kotlin.2.3.10 或更高版本
- Java 21

只需在客户端安装 `chatzle-1.0.0.jar`，服务器无需安装。

SHA-256：`b45153ad85f74304779a153034dc1a9566e7a1a7e11a7389553f36f3a222cc73`
